case_name: Dr. Hemanta Kumar Dash vs Upasana Swain
facts_of_case: The parties were in a dispute regarding the payment of Rs.16 lakhs as per a mediation report. The petitioner sought to pay the amount at once instead of three instalments.

legal_principles.principle: Parties are directed to cooperate with each other and file application under Section-13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: In view of the said submission, both the parties are directed to cooperate with each other and file application under Section-13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the Judge, Family Court, Sambalpur within 15 days hence.

legal_principles.principle: The court shall proceed further in terms of Mediation Report dated 05.11.2024, which will form part of the said joint petition of compromise.
legal_principles.held: On filing of such application, the Judge, Family Court, Sambalpur shall do well to deal with the said application and proceed further in terms of Mediation Report dated 05.11.2024, which will form part of the said joint petition of compromise, and dispose of the matter by ordering to pay the agreed amount within four weeks from the date of filing the Petition under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

outcome.final_order: Both parties are directed to cooperate and file an application under Section-13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The Judge, Family Court, Sambalpur shall dispose of the matter by ordering payment within four weeks.
